patterns.note: Full-width sections with alternating dark and light backgrounds create a clear visual rhythm and distinct content separation.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are paired with clean, readable body text, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.
A vibrant teal/mint green is used as a primary accent color against a high-contrast black and white base palette.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content engagement.
Feature sections frequently embed rich, full-width Lottie animations or video heroes to demonstrate product capabilities directly within the content flow.

technique_notes: The site uses a combination of Lottie animations, video heroes, and potentially canvas-based effects for dynamic and engaging visual content. Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by Framer Motion or Locomotive Scroll, reveal content sections with subtle fade-up or slide-in transitions as the user scrolls down the page.
Interactive elements and illustrations are integrated throughout the page, often serving as primary visual explanations rather than static images.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (up to ~4x body text) with generous line height, complemented by clear, medium-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards and buttons, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with airy hero sections and comfortable padding around content blocks, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's standout feature is its pervasive and sophisticated use of motion graphics and interactive Lottie animations as core content, not just decorative elements. It effectively uses these dynamic visuals to explain complex product features and create a highly engaging user experience that feels alive.
